description: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, relaxed Shopping, full eight-method suite at repetition_penalty=1.1 (P1). Separates a decoding-side failure from a synthesis failure: at the shared decoding condition this model produced 141/160 parse failures (repetition at the 2,048-token cap); the rp=1.1 Direct pilot cut that to 12/20. This is a separate decoding condition and must not be merged into the shared-condition tables.
